description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:LintProfile doc comment says 'If you need to run lints repeatedly, call LintProfile::lints() and construct a LintRunner manually to avoid repeated allocation.' But lints() returns &[Box<dyn Lint>] — a shared reference — and LintRunner::new() takes Vec<Box<dyn Lint>> (owned), so you cannot construct a LintRunner from a borrowed slice without cloning. The documented avoidance pattern is impossible as written. CabfTlsBrProfile::lint_runner() calls all_lints() which allocates fresh Box<dyn Lint> objects on every call. The OnceLock in lints() is never used by lint_runner(). This is an API design gap: the guidance is wrong, and lint_runner() does unnecessary allocation on every call.
title: LintProfile::lint_runner allocates fresh lints every call (documented but wrong guidance)
